LO-SD9-1.text: C2a-3's plan should revisit whether C2a-3k's in-memory re-hash after CI-3's verified transfer is needed. CI-3's open already verifies every file's length and SHA-256, and transfer re-verifies while streaming; the kernel then hashes the same bytes a third time at one edge per 64-byte block, which is 76 % to 99.6 % of SD-9's modeled subtotal edges and holds the whole tree in memory (M). Any change needs an accepted interface and accounting change: no check is removed, and no custody or admission shortcut is taken, by this observation (Q-SD9-5 ruling).
